verdict.rationale: Rive is a SaaS design/animation editor with runtimes, so outbound webhooks (for example, file or revision events) are a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Runtime data binding, state-machine events, MCP and the CLI are adjacent features, not webhooks, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
